method.affinity: Highest allowed logical CPU, owned probe processes only

method.baseline: Original full Inno.Editor.ImGui C# source at baseRevision rebuilt against the common supporting contract assemblies. Candidate uses measured dialog caller; this is not an old whole-engine binary comparison.
checks: Exactly one hundred thousand actual draws
Identical 460x684 visible window for timed work
Original auto-height transition trace recorded separately before timed fixed-extent work

unacceptedReason: Earlier implementations, changing visible work, short/noisy samples, or a P95 threshold failure. Retained as raw unsuccessful evidence; never substituted for the final set.
